core_heart_fire.name: Heart of Fire
core_heart_fire.desc: A coal that has not cooled in fifty years, wrapped in its own warmth like a held breath. The Magician's Grand Binding needs one for a Fire book.

core_heart_ice.name: Heart of Ice
core_heart_ice.desc: A knot of clear frost that fogs your glove and never melts. The Magician's Grand Binding needs one for an Ice book.

core_heart_water.name: Heart of Water
core_heart_water.desc: A drop too round to be a drop, heavy as a pebble, with a small tide moving in it. The Magician's Grand Binding needs one for a Water book.

core_heart_light.name: Heart of Light
core_heart_light.desc: A spark held so long it has learned patience. It warms the hand it rests in. The Magician's Grand Binding needs one for a Light book.

core_heart_shadow.name: Heart of Shadow
core_heart_shadow.desc: A scrap of night that stayed behind when the rest went home. It sits very quietly in the palm. The Magician's Grand Binding needs one for a Shadow book.

core_heart_earth.name: Heart of Earth
core_heart_earth.desc: A river stone with a pulse, slow as a sleeper's. It smells of rain on a cellar floor. The Magician's Grand Binding needs one for an Earth book.
